About Fireblocks

Fireblocks is the institutional standard for digital asset security and settlement. We enable banks, fintechs, and exchanges—like BNY Mellon, Revolut, and ANZ—to securely navigate the blockchain economy. Our platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets.

The Mission: Quality

The Financial Apps unit builds the critical infrastructure that connects institutions to the digital asset economy. Our products cover everything from staking and yield to on-ramps, exchange integrations, and Web3 connectivity (e.g. WalletConnect).

In this role, you'll manually test all flows that need validation, and contribute to building out our automation the rest of the time. We need someone who treats quality as a holistic product challenge, takes pride in rigorous manual testing, and is eager to help grow our automation—using AI to move faster at every stage.

· Holistic Quality Ownership: You own the quality of the product end-to-end. You don't just test against a spec; you analyze the spec, find the logical gaps, and suggest improvements to ensure a better final product.

· Hands-On Manual QA: You design and execute thorough manual test plans across complex financial and Web3 flows.

· Product Partnership: You don't see yourself as "just a tester." You are an engineer with a product mindset who actively works to improve the systems you are checking.

You take real pride in finding what others miss — exploratory testing and edge-case hunting genuinely excite you, and you'd rather break something today than let a user break it tomorrow. You do both automation and manual testing, and treat both as core parts of the role.

Experience working with financed solar assets or TPO portfolios.

This Test Engineering (TE) opportunity on the U.S. Navy’s Service Management, Integration, and Transport (SMIT) will allow participation on a high-visibility DoD program that provides engineering support to the Navy Marine Corps Intranet (NMCI), the largest information technology (IT) network in the world. This position will provide many opportunities to challenge and grow your skills as a Systems Engineer.
We are seeking a T1 Software Test Automation Engineer to join our engineering team and help drive our automated quality strategy.

In this role, you will focus on executing daily regression suites, updating existing test scripts to keep pace with minor software changes, and converting structured manual test cases into automated code under the mentorship of senior team members.

You will blend software development skills with quality assurance methodologies to validate application functionality and ensure product reliability. The ideal candidate will document clear, reproducible steps for defects in tracking systems and participate in peer code reviews to quickly grow their skills.

We are looking for an early-career professional with 0 to 2 years of experience, a solid foundational knowledge of at least one programming language (such as Java, Python, or JavaScript), basic exposure to UI automation tools, and a strong eagerness to learn.

· A successful candidate will demonstrate basic academic knowledge or introductory hands-on exposure to core test automation concepts and tools such as Robot Framework, Python, PyCharm, and GitHub. The candidate will learn and grow their skills with additional tools including GitLab, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, SonarQube, and Bitbucket as required by Leidos and the USN, with guidance from senior team members.

· The candidate will support and learn about AI-Assisted Test Automation initiatives under the mentorship of senior engineers, helping Leidos explore innovative approaches that differentiate from current industry practices in this emerging area.

· The candidate will be introduced to Cameo and will assist in building test procedures, referencing test procedures, and recording test observations and conclusions within the Naval Enterprise Network (NEN) model with training and support.

· Lab Infrastructure & Hardware Setup: Assist with hands-on assembly and basic configuration of lab environments under supervision. This includes helping set up laptops, desktop workstations, enterprise printers, and observing server rack configurations while learning troubleshooting fundamentals.

· Microsoft Stack & App Testing: Conduct functional testing of Office 365 applications (Teams, Outlook, Excel) and enterprise browsers (Edge, Chrome) to help ensure reliable performance in a managed environment, documenting findings clearly.

· Virtualization & Remote Access: Learn to validate application delivery and user experience through Citrix Workspace and Remote Desktop (RDP) tools with guidance from senior testers.

· Test Automation (Learning & Growth): Develop foundational skills in Python and Robot Framework to create and maintain simple automated "smoke tests" for new builds and hardware configurations, with code review support from senior engineers.

· Virtual Environments: Basic familiarity or willingness to quickly learn Citrix Workspace and RDP sessions for application testing.

· Programming Foundation: Introductory knowledge of Python (coursework, bootcamp, or self-study) and a strong eagerness to learn Robot Framework for test automation and orchestration.

· Operating Systems: Comfortable or willing to learn working in both Windows and Linux environments for basic system configuration and log review.

Requires B.S. Degree and 0 to 2 years of prior relevant experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical discipline from an accredited college or university.
Must be a U.S. Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.
Ability to learn and apply knowledge from multiple technical domains to solve testing challenges with guidance from senior team members.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with other technologists to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
Familiarity with or ability to quickly learn Atlassian JIRA to track work assignments, log defects, and manage test cases.
Must be able to work collaboratively in a team environment, both in-person and remotely.
Comfortable working with mentorship and oversight to develop foundational automation skills and learn innovative testing approaches.
Some travel required as needed to the Topside BSLN Lab (up to 10-25%).

Prior internship or co-op experience in software testing or quality assurance
Exposure to test automation frameworks or scripting language

Du baust mit Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein statt nach dem Prinzip „ship and pray“: Neue Flows werden zunächst inaktiv getestet , mit realistischen Testfällen geprüft und mit Deduplication-Logik, Fallbacks und Fehlerbehandlung ausgestattet, bevor sie produktiv gehen.
Du arbeitest eng mit Operations und Customer Success zusammen, übersetzt operative Pain Points in konkrete, robuste Automationen und kommunizierst proaktiv und transparent , wo ein Flow steht und warum etwas gegebenenfalls länger dauert.

Erfahrung mit dem Zoho-Ökosystem (CRM, Desk) ist ein großes Plus. Deluge-Scripting ist kein Muss – wichtiger ist deine Bereitschaft, dich schnell und selbstständig einzuarbeiten .
Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie man KI-Bausteine wie Klassifizierung oder Textgenerierung robust in produktive Workflows integriert – und weißt gleichzeitig, wo die Grenzen von Automatisierung liegen und welche Entscheidungen besser beim Menschen bleiben.
Du bringst solide Kenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript oder Python mit, um bei Bedarf Custom-Code-Nodes zu entwickeln.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und sicherheitsbewusst : Du denkst an Testfälle vor der Aktivierung, Fallbacks im Fehlerfall und eine gute Nachvollziehbarkeit , damit auch andere deine Flows später problemlos verstehen und warten können.
Du kommunizierst proaktiv und klar – auch dann, wenn etwas länger dauert oder nicht wie geplant läuft. Operations und Customer Success können sich auf dich als verlässlichen Partner verlassen.
Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude und Cursor gerne als Produktivitäts-Booster, um schneller zu arbeiten, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen .
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1) .
